What a VPN does—and doesn’t do

A VPN creates an encrypted connection between your device and a VPN endpoint. It changes who handles part of your network traffic; it does not make you anonymous or protect you from every online threat.

A calmer approach to computer security

Start with supported software, automatic updates, unique passwords, multifactor authentication, and recoverable backups. These habits address common risks without adding a pile of security utilities.
